text: そこで　おまえ　たちには　わしの　かわりに　ゆめを　はたして　ほしいのじゃ！

structure.jp: ゆめを　はたして　ほしいのじゃ！
structure.en: I want you to fulfil my dream!

patterns.name: 〜てほしい
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus ほしい means you want someone else to do it. The person you want it from takes に. はたして　ほしい = 'I want you to fulfil it'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end adds a feeling of explaining or stressing. のじゃ is how old men say it. ほしいのじゃ = 'I want it, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜のかわりに
patterns.explanation: のかわりに after a person means 'instead of' that person. わしの　かわりに = 'in my place'.
